testcase.name: InboxPage > shows a message when no mailbox is available yet
InboxPage > shows a loading indicator while messages are being fetched
InboxPage > shows an empty-state message when the folder has no messages
InboxPage > shows an error message when loading messages fails
InboxPage > shows a generic error message when loading messages fails with a non-API error
InboxPage > lists messages and shows a placeholder until one is selected
InboxPage > selects a message, marks it read, and shows its reading pane
InboxPage > does not re-mark an already-read message as read
InboxPage > swallows a failed mark-as-read update rather than blocking the reading pane
InboxPage > lists and links to attachments for a message that has them
InboxPage > silently shows no attachments when the attachment list fails to load
InboxPage > falls back to the raw address and '(no subject)' when displayName/subject are absent
InboxPage > formats attachment sizes across byte/KB/MB tiers
InboxPage > clears the attachment list when a message without attachments is reselected
NotFoundPage > renders a not-found message
